title: Unit Event — Grow Glorious Glow

meta.Outline: MORE MORE JUMP! haven't received any job offers in a while, but one day, an email arrives for Shizuku. It invites her to audition for popular cosmetics brand Grand Fleur's new commercial...

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Please wait here a moment.

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Today's audition is set to proceed as scheduled.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay, thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(Don't worry...
You've done everything you can until now.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I have to do what I did during practice, and pass this audition no matter what.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (For the sake of everyone involved in MORE MORE JUMP!)
A few weeks earlier
MORE MORE HOUSE

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What? Somebody is asking me to audition for them...?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
Yes, that's right!
I just received this email a second ago!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
It's from a company called “B1 Products”.
They do video production for commercials and music videos.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Apparently, they're going to hold an audition at the end of this month to find an actress to appear in their next commercial. And they want you to try for the role, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
A commercial...?
If it's one of those that's going to be broadcast all over the country, then it'll be a huge chance for us to get our name out there.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, what is this commercial for?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: You're not gonna believe it...!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: It's going to be a commercial for Gran Fleur's latest line of eye shadows! And it's going to be broadcast nationwide!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Gran Fleur...?!
They're one of the biggest cosmetics companies out there!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah, and their commercials always feature really famous actresses!
They're really popular for their “sophisticated lady” feel.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Yes, they normally do target those in their twenties and thirties, but things are different this time around. They have a younger demographic in mind, which is why they want a younger actress.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Still, it's hard to believe that I'm being asked to audition for a Gran Fleur commercial...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This definitely seems like an enormous opportunity for us.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Appearing in a Gran Fleur commercial would give our reputation a huge boost, since they're always so beautifully made.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Plus, appearing in this commercial would mean becoming the face of the brand.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Between product-launch events and magazine interviews, your media exposure has a chance to increase significantly as a result!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What do you say, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I don't see any reason to turn down this offer, but I'd also like to hear your opinion first.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: To be honest, I'm a little unsure...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: When I was still modelling, I heard that only the chosen few get to appear in Gran Fleur commercials. In other words, this audition isn't going to be easy...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'd like to give it a try.
Especially since I don't know if I'll ever get an opportunity like this again.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Okay, got it.
Then, go do your best!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: In that case, I'll let them know you'd like to audition for this role!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay, thank you very much...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, Saito, that reminds me!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Have we received any other offers besides this one...?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: No...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: I didn't see anything else in my inbox.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: I actually tried seeing if there was something wrong with the delivery system, but everything has been working correctly. I'm still in the middle of figuring out what's going on...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It doesn't make any sense that we'd suddenly stop receiving offers like this. It just isn't natural.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I agree...
Even if we were to stop getting offers, it would happen more gradually than this.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Exactly. We need to keep investigating the root cause of all this, but...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Regardless of what that cause is, what we do isn't going to change.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We have to keep doing everything we can, in order to continue moving forward bit by bit.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Which means...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I promise to do my absolute best for this audition.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: If I manage to win this role, then we may start receiving offers again like we previously did.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thank you.
But try not to pressure yourself too much.
This is a problem that we have to solve together.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Let's all keep doing our best and continue making progress towards our Butokan show!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, let's...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I am honestly a little worried about taking on such a big challenge all by myself like this...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But I have to do everything I can today, for the sake of the others.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Still...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (The others here are all so beautiful and have such presence. In that sense, it's really starting to feel like an audition for a Gran Fleur commercial.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (And I have to outdo all of them...)
Hinomori?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?
se_walk_women_005_1

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
You're Hagiyama from ReLight, yes...?
I didn't realize that you'd also be auditioning.

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line:
Yes...
I also didn't know that you'd be here, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. We haven't seen each other since Idol Lovers. It's so nice to see you again.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Also, it's such a relief to see a familiar face.
I was starting to get a little nervous, all on my own.

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line: A relief...?

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Next, numbers eleven to fifteen, please make your way to the auditioning area.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, you'll have to excuse me.
I'm number fourteen, so I need to go...

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line:
Then, that means we're in the same group.
I'm number fifteen.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Wait, really...?!

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line:
Let's both do our best.
But as rivals instead of fellow performers this time.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, let's...!
Audition Venue

rows.Speaker: Models
rows.Line: Pardon us.

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line:
Ah, come in.
Please find a seat along the wall according to your number.
se_walk_women_005_4

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I was under the impression that we'd be called one at a time, but I guess they're having us audition in groups...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(I see three judges...
One appears to be from Gran Fleur, another from the production company and...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (That person seems awfully familiar...)

rows.Speaker: Oikawa
rows.Line: Alright, it's great that you have a lot of presence, but I think you're going a bit overboard.

rows.Speaker: Oikawa
rows.Line:
So, try instead to stand out less.
How about you turn around and look over your shoulder? Your side profile's enough.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: O-Of course...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(It's Mr. Oikawa...!
He helped me so much when he was the creative director for Cheerful * Days.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (He's become so famous within the industry that some call him the “big hit machine”.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (This means I have to do my best today to win his approval...!)

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Alright, let's get this audition started.

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: First, this commercial is going to require two people. As such, two will be selected in the end.

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Now, we will be looking for you to be “overwhelmingly brilliant”.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(Overwhelmingly brilliant...
That's the tagline from the document we received.)

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: We'll be using the front camera to take shots from afar and up close. Please pose accordingly based on each situation.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Regardless of how many times I've done this before, expressing myself while standing motionless is still incredibly challenging for me...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But I need to strike the perfect poses here!)

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line:
Alright, we'll start with number eleven.
Please come forward.

rows.Speaker: Model #11
rows.Line: That's me...!

rows.Speaker: Model #11
rows.Line:
Number eleven, Tomomi Yuki.
Thank you for having me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (It's begun...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (We're starting by shooting from a distance...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(She's very good...
Her core seems so solid, and her pose is refined...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (In particular, the way she's lifting her hair. She's making it so the viewers' eyes are naturally drawn to her own.)

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Next, the camera will be moving in for a close-up.

rows.Speaker: Model #11
rows.Line: Ready!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(Her facial expression is mesmerizing...
She seems so strong and composed.)

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line:
Okay.
Would either of you like to see her do any other poses?

rows.Speaker: Oikawa
rows.Line: Hmm... Nothing from me.

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line:
Me as well...
I think I've seen enough.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (What...?)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(They don't sound all that satisfied...
But I thought she did such a beautiful job...)

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Unfortunately, Ms. Yuki, that will be it for you. Thank you for coming.

rows.Speaker: Model #11
rows.Line: Thank you again for having me...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (This audition is going to be much more difficult than I expected...)
A few minutes later

rows.Speaker: Oikawa
rows.Line: Hmm... Stop there.

rows.Speaker: Quiet Model
rows.Line:
Okay...
Thank you for having me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(I thought she also did a wonderful job...
But the bar they've set seems to be very high.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Still, I've done everything possible to prepare for this day. I just need to believe in myself and strike the best poses I can.)

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Next, number fourteen, please come forward.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Of course.

rows.Speaker: Oikawa
rows.Line:
Oh, Hinomori, you're next?!
I'm ready to get totally blown away by you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Th-Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Mr. Oikawa remembered who I am.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Which means I can't afford to let him down...!)
se_walk_women_005_1

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Number fourteen, Shizuku Hinomori.
Thank you for having me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (First, I'll be posing from a distance.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Their new line of eye shadows are slightly more intense than normal and include lamé... They're Gran Fleur's most showy yet.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Coupled with their “overwhelmingly brilliant” tagline, the makers must be trying to say...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(“Have confidence in yourself.”
That has to be what they want the wearers of this eye shadow to feel.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Which means...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(I need to look proud and confident.
Puff out your chest and stand tall...!)

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line:
...!
Shizuku Hinomori really has a brilliance to her.

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Next, we'll move in for a close-up.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Understood!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I'll need to come up with an even better expression for my close-up.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (In order for me to put on a proud and confident expression, then I need to...)

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line:
Interesting.
What a captivating gaze.

rows.Speaker: Oikawa
rows.Line: Yes, it's not bad...

rows.Speaker: Oikawa
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Oikawa
rows.Line: Something seems different about you, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh? Different...?

rows.Speaker: Oikawa
rows.Line:
Hmm... No, nevermind.
Anyway, could you give us a different angle?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Y-Yes, of course...!

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line:
Ah, that's also a nice expression.
It encapsulates the tagline very nicely.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Th-Thank you very much...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Mr. Oikawa still seems unsatisfied.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(Am I missing something...?
What is it that I'm failing to capture...?)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Also, what did he mean by me being different...?)

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line:
We'll have you stop here, Ms. Hinomori.
Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Y-Yes...
Thank you for having me.

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Next, number fifteen, please come forward.

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Oh, Hagiyama...)
se_walk_women_005_1

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line: Number fifteen, Yu Hagiyama.

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line: Thank you for having me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Hagiyama's expression just changed...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (She has a much stronger and sharper look on her face now...)

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: We'll be starting from afar. Please pose when you're ready.

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I can't look away from her...!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(Her pose is astonishingly simple...
All she did was shift her weight onto one leg.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Her eyes are so powerful...!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (The combination of her sharp gaze and natural pose gives her an overwhelming amount of presence.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(She isn't pandering or yielding to anyone.
She's as good as saying it out loud.)

rows.Speaker: Oikawa
rows.Line: This is good...

rows.Speaker: Oikawa
rows.Line: Can you give us a different angle, Hagiyama?

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line: Of course!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Now I see...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Now I know what I was missing. It was this...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (This painfully bright light...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (It really is blinding...)
A few days later
MORE MORE HOUSE - Practice Room

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I think that was the best run we've had of it so far.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Then, let's take a ten-minute break, but let's not forget how that felt!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Okay!
Time for some water...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, Shizuku, that reminds me!
Have you heard back about your audition yet?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
No, I haven't heard back from them...
It's been almost a week, so I think it should be soon...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, it's best not to dwell on this stuff! You know what they say! Good things come to those who wait.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
Shizuku!
The results of that audition just came in!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right on cue.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: S-So, how did she do...?!
bgm_area00002
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Really...?!
It's wonderful to hear that you passed.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Congratulations, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And you're gonna be working with Hagiyama from ReLight, right?! She seems like the perfect choice, since she has such a nice shine to her! Now I can't wait to see your commercial!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Me neither. There's no doubt that she's good, so I'm sure you two are going to produce a great commercial.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, well...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, you don't seem all that happy for some reason. Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The truth is... I'm scared.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You're scared...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm afraid that I'm going to ruin this commercial.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Ruin it? What makes you think that?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Because Hagiyama was truly overwhelming during that audition...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I took one look at her and realized that she possesses something which I don't.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm honestly wondering if I have what it takes to be paired with her...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Slow down...!
What do you mean you don't have what it takes? That's ridiculous—

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
That's just the truth of it.
She stands miles ahead of me.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: In other words, this Hagiyama girl must really be something else.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: She is...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: However, if I keep feeling this way, it's definitely going to negatively affect the quality of our commercial.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: They chose me, so I need to do my best to make it as good as I possibly can.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Okay...
But you shouldn't have to carry this all on your own.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What she said. We're here to help, so ask us if you ever need any!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We should be able to give you some assistance by watching you pose and such...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: All of you...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you. I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(We start shooting in just a few weeks.
I honestly don't know how much I'll be able to improve by then.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But if it means getting even a little bit closer to the brilliance Hagiyama possesses...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(I have to try...!
For the sake of MORE MORE JUMP!)
A few days later
Production Office

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Good morning!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm Shizuku Hinomori from MORE MORE JUMP! Thank you for having me here today.

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line:
Yes, thank you for coming.
We're almost ready to begin fitting you, so please have a seat and wait here.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Understood.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (All we're doing today is trying on our outfits for the shoot.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But everybody involved is here, so I have to stay focused.)
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line: Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, Hagiyama...!

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line: Once again, I look forward to working with you on this commercial.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I'm also looking forward to working with you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You were so incredible during that audition. I promise to do everything I can in order to keep up with you.

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line:
Thank you...
I really appreciate you saying that, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, Hagiyama...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Can you tell me what was going through your mind during the audition?

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line: What was going through my mind...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes.
I know it's a very open-ended question...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I'd like to have a better understanding of your thought process, since we're going to be working together.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I want to know how you were able to shine so brilliantly that time.

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line:
...
I just...

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line:
My thought was...
To pose in a way which exceeded everyone's expectations.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Their expectations...?

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line:
I have to keep going above and beyond.
My presence has to be powerful enough to blow others away.

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line: I was sure that was the answer, so I decided to pose accordingly.

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line: After all, the theme of this commercial demands that from us...

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line: And more importantly, I think that's how a top idol ought to be, at all times.

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line:
But I'm still nowhere near that level.
I have to keep finding ways to improve.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hagiyama...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(But she's already so dazzling.
Despite that, she still feels...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (No, her resolve is precisely why her technical acuity is so high.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But I...)
One hour later
Fitting Area

rows.Speaker: Stylists
rows.Line:
Okay!
I'm seeing no issues with your outfit!

rows.Speaker: Stylists
rows.Line:
Actually, I'm sorry...
I need to quickly go ask about which accessories we'll be using, so would you mind waiting here for a bit? Call it a short break.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, that's fine.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (It seems like they'll be done fitting me very soon...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Which means I need to begin strengthening my resolve in preparation for our shoot...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(No...
I can think that all I want, but I don't actually know how to do that...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'm sorry, but...
I'd like to go for a bit of fresh air.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(Keep it together...
I can't let this chance slip.)

rows.Speaker: Oikawa's Voice
rows.Line: Yikes, what do we do now?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(Huh? Mr. Oikawa...?
And that looks like the director, Mr. Saeki, next to him...)

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line:
I don't know...
Our client has every right to make this request, but as things stand, the balance just isn't there...

rows.Speaker: Oikawa
rows.Line: Right. Hinomori isn't bad for this...

rows.Speaker: Oikawa
rows.Line: But she sort of pales in comparison to Hagiyama's brilliant aura.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (It's just as I suspected...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But I don't blame them for feeling that way. It's true, compared to her, I leave a lot to be desired in skill and in mindset...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I have to accept that, and keep finding ways to improve.)

rows.Speaker: Oikawa
rows.Line: Maybe asking Hinomori to audition was a mistake...

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: Oh, were you the one who said to get her in to audition for this?

rows.Speaker: Oikawa
rows.Line:
Yeah, it was me.
We didn't stand to gain much since she doesn't belong to an agency, but I wanted to see that aura again.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (What...?)

rows.Speaker: Oikawa
rows.Line: You wouldn't believe how dazzling she was back then. She was just like Hagiyama. No, even more brilliant...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(Mr. Oikawa...
He thought that highly of me...?)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But to say I possessed an aura that was more brilliant than Hagiyama's seems...)

rows.Speaker: Oikawa

Honestly...
You and Haruka already checked over the footage, right?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Y-Yes, but this is a completely different situation. That time, I watched it as this group's manager... That's totally different from getting to watch it as a fan as it releases...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I know exactly how you feel, Saito!
Let's get ourselves mentally prepared by taking some deep breaths!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Thank you for understanding, Minori...!

rows.Speaker: Minori & Saito
rows.Line:
*Inhale*
*Exhale*

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
Alright...!
Here we go...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <Make your eyes more radiant.>

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line: <Capture their attention, and never let go.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku & Yu
rows.Line: <Be overwhelmingly brilliant with the new Floraison Eclat line of colors.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku & Yu
rows.Line: <Gran Fleur.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: O-O-Oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Woooooow!
Sh-Sh-Sh-Sh-Sh-She's so beautiful!!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wh-Wh-Wh-Wh-What do I do...?!
I want to express how pretty Shizuku looks, but I'm struggling to find the right words...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Same...
She's also left me totally speechless...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Still, she really did look gorgeous.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah!!
Thank goodness this commercial turned out so amazingly well...!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wait a second...
Where'd Saito go?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Why are you bawling your eyes out?!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: B-Because Shizuku looked so divine...!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
*Sob*
I'm so glad to be alive right now...
This is the last thing I want to see before I depart this world...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You like it that much?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: N-No, Saito, we need you to live a long, healthy life!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
Yes...!
I shall live alongside Shizuku, and go to the grave with her...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. It may be a little while before she stops crying.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
But this was pretty incredible...
I really couldn't take my eyes off of you. I felt totally overwhelmed.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Now I'm starting to feel a little embarrassed.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No, you deserve to be showered with even more praise! That close-up in particular was just a beauty overload!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
Oh, look here...!
People are already posting tons of comments about this commercial.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Look at that.
Everyone's going gaga for Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
“She's the elixir of life,” and, “The fairest of them all.”
“I feel rejuvenated after seeing Shizuku's beauty.”
Yes, these people get it!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's even getting a lot of traction on social media. If this keeps up, it might make it into the trending section.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Look at this, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
“Shizuku's in a different idol group now?”
“I wanna see MORE MORE JUMP! Do a commercial together next!”
“When's the next time they're gonna be on TV...?”

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Everyone's talking about MORE MORE JUMP! now because of you, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Shizuku made sure to mention MORE MORE JUMP! during the making-of video and interview for this commercial, so I have a feeling we'll be seeing more comments like these soon.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank goodness...
I hope this leads to us receiving more offers for work...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
It may not happen immediately...
But if this many people are already talking about us, then we should be able to turn our current situation around.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Because their voices carry a lot of weight.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Right...
At the very least, we should be able to knock something loose.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And we have you to thank, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Because you worked really, really hard for all of us!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you so much, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You're welcome...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I'm so glad that I decided to take on this challenge.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I've been able to help the others...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (And regain a very important piece of myself, which got lost somewhere along the way.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I'm prepared to carry everyone forward and keep shining as brightly as I can.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I'm not about to let that feeling go.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I need to keep getting better and better...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (For the sake of our group's future...!!)
